text: Luz Saúde has more than 30 health units in Portugal, including Hospital da Luz. Macquarie Asset Management's European Infrastructure Fund 7 agreed in September 2025 to buy 40% of Luz Saúde from Fidelidade, which keeps 60%. Fidelidade's shareholders page lists Fosun Group (through Millennium Gain Limited) with 84.9892%, a Chinese private conglomerate listed as Fosun International Limited in Hong Kong, and Caixa Geral de Depósitos (CGD), a bank owned by the Portuguese State, with 15%.
short: Hospital da Luz is Luz Saúde's (60% Fidelidade); Fidelidade is 84.9892% Fosun Group and 15% state-owned CGD.
